raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical extent of the square domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 specifies a square but gives no physical side length L or length units. The 64×64 statements elsewhere describe resolution. Effects depend on how dimensional thickness and filter lengths are scaled.",
      "readings": [
        "Domain [0,1]×[0,1] in normalized length units",
        "Domain [0,64]×[0,64], with unit-width elements if using a 64×64 mesh"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.1 and 4.6 do not specify thickness or a per-unit-thickness convention for assembling the two-dimensional stiffness matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same units, retaining the same total applied force"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Supported portions of the bracket boundary",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 and the Fig. 6 caption identify a shelf bracket but give no support locations, number of mounting regions, or supported lengths.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire left edge x=0, 0≤y≤L",
        "Only the two left corners (0,0) and (0,L)",
        "Upper half of the left edge x=0, L/2≤y≤L"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement constraints at mounting locations",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the case description nor its caption states which displacement components are restrained; Sec. 4.1 only counts boundary-condition configurations.",
      "readings": [
        "Both ux and uy fixed at every supported node",
        "ux fixed along a vertical mounting segment, with uy fixed at one endpoint",
        "Two mounting points: both components fixed at one point and only ux fixed at the other"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Location of the prescribed load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 permits random unconstrained boundary nodes, but Sec. 4.6 does not identify the node or boundary position used for Fig. 6.",
      "readings": [
        "Upper-right corner (L,L)",
        "Midpoint of the right edge (L,L/2)",
        "Midpoint of the top edge (L/2,L)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the prescribed load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 describes boundary-node loading for the dataset. Sec. 4.6 does not explicitly establish whether the bracket inherits a single-node load or uses a shelf-contact loading region.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one boundary node",
        "Same total force divided equally between two adjacent boundary nodes",
        "Uniform traction on the top-edge segment 3L/4≤x≤L"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 supplies an angle set but does not select the Fig. 6 direction or define its angular coordinate convention. Sec. 4.6 supplies no direction.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward",
        "Horizontally rightward",
        "Downward and rightward, 60 degrees below horizontal"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 4.1 nor the Fig. 6 case description gives a force magnitude or force units.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant magnitude 1 in consistent force units",
        "Resultant magnitude 10 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Prescribed volume fraction for Fig. 6",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 defines vf and Sec. 4.1 lists dataset values, but Sec. 4.6 does not select the bracket's value.",
      "readings": [
        "0.30",
        "0.32",
        "0.34",
        "0.36",
        "0.38",
        "0.40",
        "0.42",
        "0.44",
        "0.46",
        "0.48",
        "0.50"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed-solid attachment and loading regions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 does not state whether attachment or load-introduction elements are protected from removal, or give a fixed-solid mask.",
      "readings": [
        "No fixed-solid elements",
        "Every element incident on a loaded or supported node fixed at density 1",
        "A one-element-wide strip along the mounting boundary fixed at density 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed voids or mounting clearances",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 and the caption do not state whether the square contains compulsory empty regions, such as mounting holes.",
      "readings": [
        "No prescribed void regions",
        "A circular mounting hole centered at (L/8,L/2), radius L/32, held at the minimum density"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 introduces K without elastic constants; Sec. 4.6 reports compliance without specifying the solid modulus or its units.",
      "readings": [
        "E0=1 in consistent normalized units",
        "E0=100 in the same units, with the same relative void stiffness"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for the Fig. 6 material or the general FEA model.",
      "readings": [
        "nu=0.25",
        "nu=0.30",
        "nu=0.35"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The in-plane stress representation in Appendix F does not distinguish plane stress from plane strain; Sec. 4.6 does not resolve this.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Case-specific grid resolution",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.7.3, Table 8, and Appendix C identify 64×64 benchmark grids, but Sec. 4.6 does not explicitly assign that grid to the illustrative Fig. 6 case.",
      "readings": [
        "64×64 elements, inheriting the native benchmark grid",
        "128×128 elements, treating Fig. 6 as a separately discretized illustrative case"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies equilibrium and Sec. 4.2 refers to a standard FEA solver, without naming element order or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with stabilized one-point integration",
        "Eight-node serendipity quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Minimum relative density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) requires a positive xmin but never assigns its value.",
      "readings": [
        "xmin=0.01",
        "xmin=0.001",
        "xmin=0.000001"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP stiffness interpolation, penalization, and continuation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 names SIMP but supplies no stiffness interpolation, penalty exponent, added void-stiffness floor, or continuation schedule.",
      "readings": [
        "E(x)=E0*x^3, with fixed exponent 3 and no additive stiffness floor",
        "E(x)=E0*[1e-9+(1-1e-9)*x^3], with fixed exponent 3",
        "E(x)=E0*[1e-9+(1-1e-9)*x^4], with fixed exponent 4",
        "Same additive-floor interpolation, with p=1 for iterations 1–50, p=2 for 51–100, and p=3 thereafter"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Spatial filtering operator",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 3.1 nor the Fig. 6 SIMP description specifies numerical filtering or its kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "No spatial filter",
        "Sensitivity filtering with linear distance weights",
        "Density filtering with linear distance weights",
        "Density filtering with Gaussian weights"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No filter radius or smoothing length is stated for the bracket reference solution.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear-weight filter cutoff radius r=1.5h, where h is element width",
        "Linear-weight filter cutoff radius r=2h",
        "Linear-weight filter cutoff radius r=3h"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper gives no rule for filtering near the square boundary or attachment regions.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate neighborhoods to the domain and renormalize remaining weights",
        "Treat exterior cells as void and retain full-kernel normalization",
        "Reflect the density field across domain boundaries"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density projection during optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 does not specify an optimization projection. The evaluation threshold tau=0.5 in Sec. 4.2 does not define a projection used during SIMP.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection during optimization",
        "Smooth tanh Heaviside projection with eta=0.5 and fixed beta=1",
        "Smooth tanh Heaviside projection with eta=0.5 and beta increased through 1, 2, 4, and 8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.7.2 specifies uniform densities for physics-feature preprocessing, not the initialization of the Fig. 6 SIMP optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density x=vf",
        "Uniform density x=1",
        "Uniform x=vf plus seed-0 uniform noise in [-0.01,0.01], adjusted to preserve the initial mean vf"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP update algorithm and move control",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Naming SIMP in Sec. 4.6 does not identify the numerical optimizer or its step restrictions.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria update with maximum density change 0.2 per iteration",
        "Optimality-criteria update with maximum density change 0.1 per iteration",
        "MMA updates with a density move limit of 0.2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization termination",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.6 supplies no SIMP stopping rule. Table 8's timing label of 100 steps does not explicitly establish the iteration count or convergence criterion for Fig. 6.",
      "readings": [
        "Run exactly 100 optimization iterations",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.01, with a 200-iteration cap",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.001, with a 1000-iteration cap"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Equilibrium-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) and the standard-FEA wording in Sec. 4.2 do not specify the linear solver or its numerical tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision sparse direct solve",
        "Conjugate-gradient solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Conjugate-gradient solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
